regions.name: Rio Ereré
regions.quote: Type locality is 'Rio Ereré, tributary to Rio Negro, Brazil', and local fishermen apparently consider it restricted to the Ereré plus the rios Demeni and Aracá, all minor tributaries close to the town of Barcelos in the middle Negro.
